confirmation_logic.internal_chain: confirms KIBRA blocks, emissions, difficulty, shares accounting
confirmation_logic.external_chain_anchor: confirms timestamp, hash, public existence of shares/blocks
confirmation_logic.dex_pool: confirms reference market price if real reserves and verifiable pool proof exist
confirmation_logic.orderbook_provider: confirms market price if real bids/asks or provider quote is verified
confirmation_logic.reserve_backed_peg: confirms peg only if reserve, redemption policy, custody/provider proof and OWNER approval exist
